notes.title: 1.6.10 EA
notes.content: [h3][b]SPW Audio Quality Badges[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Added new badges: "HQ", "CD", "CD+", "HiRes", and "RAW". A full music library rescan is required for these to take effect:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/b613bf4e33e9c8da5aa7d9ea29b33fa654f07a73.png"][/img][/p][p]If undesired, these badges can be disabled in the "Track Item" appearance settings:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/0329b5f4ba4e7fa5c387e1ba51a92f8a26aabc25.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Auto-hide Mini Player Controls[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Added a new "Auto-hide mini player controls" option (located in the Accessibility settings):[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/bb150e72bfa984c9e1303308714e779a41d87271.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Mouse Wheel Volume Adjustment[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Added the ability to quickly adjust volume using the mouse wheel over the volume button on the mini player:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/e4fb1bdd74f3f73080913d5a63265b86288ae461.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Japanese and Korean Localization[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/f58b42db266daafb2c40fd5d1510dbe4dc2a0cab.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Other New Features[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Added a "Copy file path" option to the track item context menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added a dB conversion hint for the volume control[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for scanning and playing DSD files (with extensions .dff/.dsf)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Optimizations and Changes[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Optimized Traditional Chinese, Russian, and Indonesian localizations[/p][/*][*][p]Changed default behavior so that newly added Mods are initially disabled[/p][/*][*][p]Deprecated the use of the disabled.txt file within the workshopmod folder[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the artist field in SMTC (System Media Transport Controls) might not update correctly[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added new badges: "HQ", "CD", "CD+", "HiRes", and "RAW". A full music library rescan is required for these to take effect:

notes.title: 1.6.0 EA Changelog
notes.content: [h3]Added Checkboxes for Song List Selection[/h3][p][/p][p]SPW's song list has always supported Ctrl for single selection, Shift for range selection, and other shortcuts similar to Windows Explorer, but many users were unaware of this. Now, checkboxes are displayed by default to clearly indicate that multi-selection is supported.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/bef5855bce37803f01a46f848159deeb67cd4886.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you don't like this feature, you can disable it. The setting is located in "Appearance" -> "Track Item Appearance". You can also access it via the right-click context menu in the song list.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/d8ffb01396c4ad531c9b8ced8cc00b53986fa72c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Remember Desktop Lyric Position[/h3][p][/p][p]SPW can now remember the last adjusted position of the desktop lyrics, so it will be restored the next time you launch the application.[/p][p][/p][h3]Other New Additions[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Added the ability to delete modules[/p][/*][*][p]Added a confirmation dialog for deleting playlists[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Optimizations and Changes[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Optimized the clarity of album art on the album interface[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the layout of the lyrics settings interface for a more logical categorization and added a preview for the blur effect on non-current lyrics[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the rendering speed of the sunglow effect[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the -restartsteam parameter for the Steam version as it is no longer in use[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the input format check for creating and editing playlists was incorrect[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where minimizing the window while maximized and then reopening it would cause it to become a floating window[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where parsing certain formats caused incorrect truncation of track titles[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where seeking in lyrics could not return to the initial, pre-playback state[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in WASAPI playback mode where pausing and then switching tracks could leave residual sound[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several other minor issues[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Steam Offline Usage Instructions[/h3][p][/p][p]By default, Steam creates a shortcut on your desktop with the address steam://rungameid/3009140, which launches the application through Steam. If you need to use it offline, you must run the executable file directly. To do this, go to your Steam Library, right-click on "Salt Player for Windows", select "Manage" -> "Browse local files". In the folder that opens, you will find "Salt Player for Window.exe". You can create a shortcut to this file and place it on your desktop.[/p]

tags.feature: Now, checkboxes are displayed by default to clearly indicate that multi-selection is supported.
SPW can now remember the last adjusted position of the desktop lyrics, so it will be restored the next time you launch the application.
Added the ability to delete modules
Added a confirmation dialog for deleting playlists

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where the input format check for creating and editing playlists was incorrect
Fixed an issue where minimizing the window while maximized and then reopening it would cause it to become a floating window
Fixed an issue where parsing certain formats caused incorrect truncation of track titles
Fixed an issue where seeking in lyrics could not return to the initial, pre-playback state
Fixed an issue in WASAPI playback mode where pausing and then switching tracks could leave residual sound

notes.title: 1.5.21 EA
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Steam offline login support. SPW can now be used normally without opening Steam. A "Steam Disconnected" prompt will appear in the title bar, with a "Retry" menu option available for reconnection as needed.
[*] Added support for the year in the FLAC tag "DATE".
[*] Added sticky header support for sorting songs by year.
[*] Improved album categorization.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.5.20 EA Released! Sunglow Effect, Image Loading Overhaul, and More
notes.content: [h3][b]Sunglow Effect Returns!​[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The "Sunglow" effect, which was added in the test version but later disabled, has made a comeback. Compared to the test version, GPU usage has been optimized, though it remains a relatively GPU-intensive feature. As a result, it is disabled by default. The Sunglow effect is similar to the mobile version's "Streamer Light" effect but with some improvements. Feel free to try it out! The toggle can be found in ​[b]Settings → Appearance → Playback Interface[/b]:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/45b2201835648a134ca17d6efa84fbad37ac1d73.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]More Right-Click Menu Navigation Options[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Added navigation options in the song right-click menu to jump to ​[b]Album[/b], ​[b]Album Artist[/b], and ​[b]Performing Artist[/b]:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/dc204cb44f2e3ea2777282c08fbd7237c388bbec.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Image Loading Overhaul[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The new version significantly improves image loading speed, including enhanced performance for indexed-color PNGs and interlaced PNGs, as well as better thumbnail display quality. Additionally, the rendering speed for progressive JPEG embedded covers has been increased by dozens of times. Support for embedded WEBP images has also been added.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]SPW Workshop API Update[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Refer to the updates in ​[b]SPW Workshop API 0.1.0-dev08[/b]:[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://github.com/Moriafly/spw-workshop-api"]https://github.com/Moriafly/spw-workshop-api[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Desktop Lyrics Improvements[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Optimized desktop lyrics to remain visible above the taskbar[/p][/*][*][p]Improved outline visibility for desktop lyrics in light backgrounds[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced text display when no song or lyrics are available[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Other Optimizations and Fixes[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Improved cover animation in the playback interface when switching songs[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced accessibility display scaling, now adjustable down to ​[b]90%​[/b]​ with a minimum step of ​[b]1%​[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Improved default playback interface appearance for songs without covers[/p][/*][*][p]Refined some text descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the default setting for multi-layer blur to ​[b]enabled[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where genre tags would not clear automatically[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where log files were not automatically cleaned up[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where desktop lyrics displayed window icons in the taskbar[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Thank you for supporting Salt Player for Windows![/b][/p]

tags.feature: The "Sunglow" effect, which was added in the test version but later disabled, has made a comeback. Compared to the test version, GPU usage has been optimized, though it remains a relatively GPU-intensive feature. As a result, it is disabled by default. The Sunglow effect is similar to the mobile version's "Streamer Light" effect but with some improvements. Feel free to try it out! The toggle can be found in ​[b]Settings → Appearance → Playback Interface[/b]:
Added navigation options in the song right-click menu to jump to ​[b]Album[/b], ​[b]Album Artist[/b], and ​[b]Performing Artist[/b]:

The new version significantly improves image loading speed, including enhanced performance for indexed-color PNGs and interlaced PNGs, as well as better thumbnail display quality. Additionally, the rendering speed for progressive JPEG embedded covers has been increased by dozens of times. Support for embedded WEBP images has also been added.
Refer to the updates in ​[b]SPW Workshop API 0.1.0-dev08[/b]:
Optimized desktop lyrics to remain visible above the taskbar
Improved outline visibility for desktop lyrics in light backgrounds
Enhanced text display when no song or lyrics are available
Improved cover animation in the playback interface when switching songs
Enhanced accessibility display scaling, now adjustable down to ​[b]90%​[/b]​ with a minimum step of ​[b]1%​[/b]
Improved default playback interface appearance for songs without covers
Refined some text descriptions
Changed the default setting for multi-layer blur to ​[b]enabled[/b]
